---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability, control signal, provider option, or DX improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

**The problem this solves**

What can't you do today, or what's painful? (A feature request anchored
in a concrete use case is much easier to evaluate than an abstract
wish — "I tried to X and had to Y" beats "support Z".)

**Proposed solution**

What you'd want Vex to do. If you've looked at the code: where you'd
expect it to live (harness / execution / runtime / memory+MCP / cli /
dashboard).

**Alternatives you considered**

Including "current workaround" if you have one.

**Scope check**

Some things are deliberately locked or deferred (see `project-spec.md`
and `CONTRIBUTING.md` §"What NOT to do"): bash-only action space, the
verifier gate, Python-only, no plugin marketplace yet. If your request
touches one of those, make the case for unlocking it.

**Additional context**

Mockups, prior art in other tools, links, anything else.
